transcribed_from: Research of step 6.7a S2.2a (2026-10-11): NKBA kitchen and bath planning guidelines, Dimensions.com bedroom layouts, walk-in closet and dining-table sizing guides, common US residential practice. Version 0.2.0 (step S2.2b, 2026-10-11): client decisions of 2026-10-11 20:30-20:35 (bed clearance 36 in at both sides and the foot; proportion and furniture hard for baths, dining room and kitchen; small spaces cover the whole wall; linen and bath closets) and the layout policy parameters.
verification_note: Design values, not code: every entry verified=false until checked against San Diego tract plans and the NKBA text. New constraints start as soft preferences and may be made hard after calibration (step S2.2f). The area range and the least side of each space type stay in the residential catalog and are registered by reference.

source.section: all
n/a

parameter_schema.note: Every value the client or the designer may define is a parameter object: value, type (number / enum / list / bool), unit, kind (hard / soft / weight / reference), who (client / designer / code), range (numbers), choices (enum / list), kinds_allowed, optional floor (a code rule the value may not cross) and a description in Spanish and English. The design registry (modules/design) reads them; the client's changes go to a design profile, never here.
